title: Reformar el Estado
goal: Read how liberal governments took birth, marriage and death records out of Church hands, why the change was controversial in Mexico's 1855-1863 Reform Laws, and what conflict it triggered.

items: Explain who traditionally kept birth, marriage and death records before liberal reform.
Describe what changed about marriage under Mexico's Leyes de Reforma.
Explain what happened to Church property under these same laws.
State how conservatives reacted, and what conflict resulted.
Use passive voice (ser + participle) to narrate a sequence of state reforms.
